companionInventory.limitation: Both native printed bibliographic footnotes retained as source attribution, without claiming their external papers are archive companions or personally read. Catalogue-bound archive identity and original packet coverage, not every document ever published elsewhere.

sourceGaps: All six available native worked keys fully transcribed, including every B3 alternate method, ellipse-curvature note, grading and author commentary. Source transcription does not certify printed key mathematical correctness.

Original question PDF is a scan with no text layer; all13 pages personally read visually. The native revised-key layer is trusted only for solutions comparison, not used to invent or replace scanned question wording.

Original question and revised-key packet pagination differ. Full original question instructions are public document notes and the unique revised-key division/scanning paragraph is separately retained. Equivalent repeated administration/questions/STOP/answer-sheet prose and blank graphs normalized to one public occurrence.

The source supplies whole-problem25points but no numeric per-subpart allocations; none invented. Both blank graph sheets have no numeric axis scales; the actual grids/labels are preserved without synthesized ticks or answers.

A3 native a/b roman groups and B1(d) connected roman parts remain native sections within whole problems. A1/A2/B2 common continuations retain native statementAfter placement. No native whole problem split.
Native AAPT/AIP cover logo is administration, its actual organiser/team/year/copyright information retained in paper metadata/document notes; no decorative logo is promoted as a task figure.

Both actual answer-sheet Student/Proctor ID fields and the original guidance sample ID29485/proctor1038/B3:2/2 example are retained as text. No native task graph, unique key diagram or useful datum omitted.
Native B2(c) original scan says osillate; revised-key repeated question says oscillate. The original question spelling and actual key wording are not silently merged.

An incorrect2018-pattern administrative paragraph appeared only in unfrozen r2 and was personally detected by reopening revised-key page1. Finalr3 replaces it with the actual2019 four-part division and scanning paragraph. Both prior raw reports/drafts retained; no separate checker claim.

sourceContradictions.description: Native key says Using a similar approach, we can find that at t3=1s with an incomplete clause; b refers to the blue line although native answer graphs are grayscale, and c says as C moves although the problem has only blocksA/B. Full printed wording and actual original grayscale graphs retained.

Native key introduces Q2=A T2^4 and (P-A T1^4)/T1=A T2^4/T2 without explicitly defining A as2piR²sigma; the original Stefan-Boltzmann hint uses A for area and later key expands hemispheric2piR²sigma. Native coefficient/notation preserved without adding an unprinted definition.
Native key calls sigma_d the charge density on the left plate, despite subscriptd/plate positiond indicating the other plate. Literal native wording retained.

For V(x)=-V0(x/d)^b and v=-mu dV/dx, native high-voltage key prints both v and rho with negative signs, despite positive-charge transport/derivative and positive final current. Low-voltage key then prints V(x)=+V0(x/d)^b without minus and uses b instead of task b-prime, inconsistent with the -V0 boundary. All native signs/exponent symbols/current formulas retained.

Native a says solving for d gives gives. Native b writes E=Q/(epsilon0 kappa A) with undefined kappa although question supplies epsilon and next voltage equation uses epsilon. Native c says inserting expression for Q from part(a), though a asks d. Actual wording/variables preserved.

Native c requires Vmax>Vth but d(i) prints Vth>Vmax while saying pumps stop. Native uncharged-state parenthetical says Q=0 and d=0 rather than questiond0, and later calls voltage maximum Vth. Native d(ii) calls threshold larger than stopping voltageVth despite earlier Vth being threshold. Printed inequalities/labels/uncharged state retained rather than silently corrected.
Original question scan spells osillate; revised-key repeat spells oscillate. Both originals visually compared; public question keeps scan spelling and evidence records the key wording difference.

Native explanation says peak around8030K while discussing wavelength-to-temperature conversion. Full native wording retained together with ±500Kof8000 grading tolerance and follow-on credit consistent with part(a).

First method says bead cannot have vertical velocity since fixed to the rod; later ellipse method reuses R for instantaneous radius of curvature as well as rod length. Actual native statements/overloaded symbols retained with all three methods for each a/b and complete c/author commentary.

rawTextLayer.scopeLimitation: Original scan has zero text-layer words, so mechanical text-layer gate cannot evaluate scanned question fidelity.
